description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic related to deep links within the application, including routes for agent and gateway connections, along with associated data models and parser.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents a deep link to connect to a gateway, including host, port, TLS, and credentials, with methods to parse from a setup code and generate WebSocket URL.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Encapsulates data for agent-related deep links, including message, session details, and delivery preferences.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON string to create a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL to determine if it matches known deep link schemes and returns the appropriate route.
